# Gangs

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/gangs.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Gang types: `CfgGang(type, ...)` configures each, `GangCreate(type, name)` creates a gang in a
level script and `CfgGangMusic` gives it three music tracks. Humans join a gang when they are created.

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every gang type (25) is listed with its arguments; the meaning of the byte values is not traced.
    Labels are hand-written.
